sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin and I'm Mark Ronson and welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰，我是马克·朗森，欢迎收听《重构者》，这是一档关于对设计的热爱以及围绕其产生的文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl,
sentences.zh: 即使是在我还在夜店里用黑胶唱片当DJ的那个年代，

sentences.en: every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you and you turned a DJ booth into this like living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 你每天晚上都要带着300件你最珍视的宝贝去工作，把DJ台变成了一个充满50年历史精美文物的临时生活博物馆。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你最喜欢的播客平台上收听爱彼出品的《重构者》吧。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴尔巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today, in his first State of the Union address, the president left behind the divisive rhetoric calling for one American family.
sentences.zh: 今天，总统在发表首次国情咨文时，抛弃了分裂性的言论，呼吁建立一个美国家庭。

sentences.en: But hidden in the many stories he told of everyday Americans acting heroically was a deeply nationalist message.
sentences.zh: 但在他讲述的许多普通美国人英勇行为的故事背后，隐藏着一种深刻的民族主义信息。

sentences.en: It's Wednesday, January 31St.
sentences.zh: 今天是1月31日，星期三。

sentences.en: Congress, I have the high privilege and the distinct honor of presenting to you the president of the United States.
sentences.zh: 国会，我有幸向各位隆重介绍美利坚合众国总统。

sentences.en: From the moment President Trump took the podium Tuesday night, it was a very different Donald Trump on display.
sentences.zh: 从特朗普总统周二晚走上讲台的那一刻起，人们看到的就是一个非常不同的唐纳德·特朗普。

sentences.en: Mark Landler was covering the State of the Union on Tuesday night.
sentences.zh: 马克·兰德勒周二晚负责报道国情咨文。

sentences.en: So let's begin tonight by recognizing that the state of our union is strong because our people are strong.
sentences.zh: 那么，让我们今晚先认识到，我们的国家状况是强大的，因为我们的人民是强大的。

sentences.en: Rather than telling Americans, he was really showing Americans a vision of the country, a vision of everyday Americans helping each other out.
sentences.zh: 他并没有向美国人说教，而是向他们展示了一个国家愿景，一个普通美国人互相帮助的愿景。

sentences.en: And very much in this part of his address, he focused on all the trials and tribulations the country had been through during his first year in office.
sentences.zh: 在演讲的这一部分，他非常着重于国家在他执政第一年所经历的所有磨难和考验。

sentences.en: We have shared in the heights of victory and the pains of hardship.
sentences.zh: 我们共同分享了胜利的高峰，也共同承受了苦难的痛楚。

sentences.en: Mass shootings in Las Vegas.
sentences.zh: 拉斯维加斯的群体枪击事件。

sentences.en: We have endured floods.
sentences.zh: 我们忍受了洪水。

sentences.en: Fires in California.
sentences.zh: 加利福尼亚的火灾。

sentences.en: And storMs.
sentences.zh: 还有风暴。

sentences.en: Hurricanes in Texas and Florida.
sentences.zh: 德克萨斯州和佛罗里达州的飓风。

sentences.en: But through it all, we have seen the beauty of America's soul and the steel in America's spine.
sentences.zh: 但历经这一切，我们看到了美国灵魂的美丽和美国脊梁的坚韧。

sentences.en: And then he pointed to people in the room, standing in the visitor's gallery, who had acted bravely and courageously and selflessly through the course of these tragedies.
sentences.zh: 随后，他指向坐在访客席上的那些人，他们在这些悲剧发生的过程中表现得勇敢、无畏且无私。

sentences.en: We heard tales of Americans like Coast Guard Petty Officer Ashley Leppert, who was one of the first helicopter pilots on the scene in Houston after Hurricane Harvey.
sentences.zh: 我们听到了像海岸警卫队士官阿什利·莱珀特这样的美国人的故事，她是哈维飓风后休斯顿现场第一批直升机飞行员之一。

sentences.en: We heard about Americans like firefighter David Dahlberg, a firefighter who faced down a wall of flames to rescue almost 60 kids trapped at a summer camp in California.
sentences.zh: 我们听到了像消防员大卫·达尔伯格这样的美国人的故事，他面对火墙，救出了被困在加州夏令营的近60名孩子。

sentences.en: The legend from Louisiana, Congressman Steve Scalise, the Louisiana Republican who survived a shooting at a congressional baseball game.
sentences.zh: 来自路易斯安那州的传奇人物，国会议员史蒂夫·斯卡利斯，这位在国会棒球赛枪击案中幸存下来的路易斯安那州共和党人。

sentences.en: And in each case, it was sort of a very heartwarming anecdote about someone who had survived a terrible experience and helped other people in the course of it.
sentences.zh: 在每一个案例中，这都是关于某人经历可怕遭遇并在此过程中帮助他人的暖心轶事。

sentences.en: Each test has forged new American heroes to remind us who we are and show us what we can be.
sentences.zh: 每一次考验都锻造了新的美国英雄，提醒我们是谁，并向我们展示我们可以成为什么样的人。

sentences.en: I mean, one of the realities of the Donald Trump presidency is that his base is only about 36 to 40 percent of the American public, depending on how you count his polling numbers.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，唐纳德·特朗普总统任期的一个现实是，他的基本盘只占美国公众的36%到40%左右，具体取决于你如何计算他的民调数字。

sentences.en: What he's trying to do in this speech is transcend those limitations, present himself as the president for all Americans, not just for his base.
sentences.zh: 他在这次演讲中试图做的是超越这些局限，将自己呈现为所有美国人的总统，而不仅仅是他的基本盘。

sentences.en: And it's an important message.
sentences.zh: 这是一个重要的信息。

sentences.en: It's one that's been much debated internally within the White House.
sentences.zh: 这也是白宫内部争论已久的话题。

sentences.en: There are those who advise President Trump that think he shouldn't do this, that he should double down on that part of America that is his base.
sentences.zh: 有些人建议特朗普总统不要这样做，认为他应该在属于他基本盘的那部分美国人身上加倍投入。

sentences.en: And then there are other people around the president that think that now is the time that he should try to expand his message.
sentences.zh: 而总统周围还有其他人认为，现在是他尝试扩大信息受众的时候了。

sentences.en: He should try to be more inclusive and make a bid for the Americans that don't consider themselves to be part of the Donald Trump movement.
sentences.zh: 他应该尝试更具包容性，并争取那些不认为自己属于唐纳德·特朗普运动的美国人。

sentences.en: Here tonight is Preston Sharp, a 12 year old boy from Redding, California, who noticed that veterans graves were not marked with flags on Veterans Day.
sentences.zh: 今晚在座的有来自加州雷丁的12岁男孩普雷斯顿·夏普，他注意到退伍军人节时退伍军人的墓碑上没有插旗。

sentences.en: He decided all by himself to change that and started a movement that has now placed 40,000 flags at the graves of our great heroes.
sentences.zh: 他独自决定改变这种情况，并发起了一项运动，现在已经在我们伟大英雄的墓碑上插上了4万面旗帜。

sentences.en: Preston, a job well done.
sentences.zh: 普雷斯顿，干得好。

sentences.en: And Mark, why do you think the president is using stories, so many stories, these individuals that he keeps evoking and telling very rich narratives about to accomplish that?
sentences.zh: 马克，你认为总统为什么要用故事，这么多故事，这些他不断提及并进行丰富叙述的个人，来达成这一目的呢？

sentences.en: I think there's two reasons.
sentences.zh: 我认为有两个原因。

sentences.en: One is a very simple one.
sentences.zh: 第一个原因很简单。

sentences.en: This was a speech that was very light on policy.
sentences.zh: 这是一场政策内容非常单薄的演讲。

sentences.en: There were really very few policy proposals or very little discussion of policy.
sentences.zh: 几乎没有什么政策提案，也很少讨论政策。

sentences.en: And stories give you a very captivating, diverting way to engage an audience without getting drawn into the specifics of policy.
sentences.zh: 而故事提供了一种非常吸引人、转移注意力的方式来吸引听众，而无需陷入政策细节。

sentences.en: And I think significantly in this speech, it's a way for him to, in almost a sub-rosa way, get some messages across to his supporters.
sentences.zh: 我认为这次演讲意义重大的一点是，这是一种让他以一种近乎隐晦的方式向支持者传达某些信息的方法。

sentences.en: Some of these stories are uplifting.
sentences.zh: 其中一些故事令人振奋。

sentences.en: Others, however, are pretty harrowing.
sentences.zh: 然而，另一些则相当令人揪心。

sentences.en: And I think he's getting some rather difficult messages across to his supporters on issues like immigration, drug abuse, Islamic militancy,
sentences.zh: 我认为他正在就移民、药物滥用、伊斯兰激进主义等问题向支持者传达一些相当棘手的信息，

sentences.en: through telling these stories that in a way make his speech both appealing to his supporters,
sentences.zh: 通过讲述这些故事，在某种程度上使他的演讲既吸引了他的支持者，

sentences.en: but more palatable to people on the other side of the aisle, who he's also trying to reach out to.
sentences.zh: 又让政治光谱另一端的人更容易接受，而这些人也是他试图接触的对象。

sentences.en: So let's talk about some of the messages that the president focused on in these stories and in the related policies to them.
sentences.zh: 那么，让我们谈谈总统在这些故事以及相关政策中关注的一些信息。

sentences.en: Well, sure.
sentences.zh: 当然可以。

sentences.en: And to begin with, he took a very long, enjoyable victory lap on the issue of the economy.
sentences.zh: 首先，他在经济问题上进行了一次漫长而愉快的胜利巡游。

sentences.en: Since the election, we have created 2.4 million new jobs.
sentences.zh: 自选举以来，我们创造了240万个新就业岗位。

sentences.en: He talked about the lowest unemployment rate.
sentences.zh: 他谈到了最低失业率。

sentences.en: Unemployment claims have hit a 45-year low.
sentences.zh: 失业救济申请人数达到了45年来的最低点。

sentences.en: Economic growth.
sentences.zh: 经济增长。

sentences.en: The stock market has smashed one record after another.
sentences.zh: 股市打破了一个又一个记录。

sentences.en: The greatest stock market.
sentences.zh: 最伟大的股市。

sentences.en: We enacted the biggest tax cuts and reforms in American history.
sentences.zh: 我们颁布了美国历史上最大的减税和改革方案。

sentences.en: So the economy and celebrating the economy and the economic expansion was really the very first part of the speech.
sentences.zh: 所以，经济以及对经济和经济扩张的庆祝，确实是演讲的第一部分。

sentences.en: It's really what he led off with.
sentences.zh: 这确实是他开篇的内容。

sentences.en: It was very much a pat on the back, taking credit for growth, much of which, it must be pointed out, is a result of policies of his predecessor, Barack Obama.
sentences.zh: 这在很大程度上是一种自我表扬，将增长归功于自己，但必须指出的是，其中大部分是其前任巴拉克·奥巴马政策的结果。

sentences.en: But he very much wanted to stamp this as the Trump economy.
sentences.zh: 但他非常希望将其打上“特朗普经济学”的烙印。

sentences.en: Here tonight are Steve Staub and Sandy Keplinger of Staub Manufacturing, a small, beautiful business in Ohio.
sentences.zh: 今晚在座的有来自俄亥俄州一家小型精美企业——斯托布制造公司的史蒂夫·斯托布和桑迪·凯普林格。

sentences.en: They've just finished the best year in their 20-year history.
sentences.zh: 他们刚刚结束了20年历史上最好的一年。

sentences.en: So, Mark,
sentences.zh: 那么，马克，

sentences.en: this anecdote that the president describes of this Ohio couple and their factory revolves around his belief that the tax cut he just passed is already helping to spur American business,
sentences.zh: 总统描述的这对俄亥俄州夫妇及其工厂的轶事，围绕着他的一种信念，即他刚刚通过的减税政策已经开始刺激美国商业，

sentences.en: and it's benefiting workers, and bringing businesses back to the United States.
sentences.zh: 并且正在造福工人，将企业带回美国。

sentences.en: Because of tax reform, they are handing out raises, hiring an additional 14 people, and expanding into the building next door.
sentences.zh: 由于税制改革，他们正在发放加薪，额外雇佣了14人，并扩展到了隔壁的建筑。

sentences.en: Good feeling.
sentences.zh: 感觉不错。

sentences.en: As far as we know, is that right?
sentences.zh: 据我们所知，是这样吗？

sentences.en: I mean, the tax cut was just passed.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，减税政策才刚刚通过。

sentences.en: Are we already seeing evidence that those things are happening?
sentences.zh: 我们已经看到这些事情正在发生的证据了吗？

sentences.en: I think it's a mixed bag.
sentences.zh: 我认为情况好坏参半。

sentences.en: Some major American companies have announced that they're repatriating large amounts of money.
sentences.zh: 一些美国大公司已经宣布他们正在汇回大量资金。

sentences.en: So, there is some fairly short-term benefit attached to this tax cut.
sentences.zh: 所以，这项减税政策确实带来了一些相当短期的好处。

sentences.en: On the other hand, particularly for small business people like the Staubs in Ohio, it is highly unlikely that they're really feeling any measurable impact from this.
sentences.zh: 另一方面，特别是对于像俄亥俄州斯托布夫妇这样的小企业主来说，他们几乎不可能真正感受到任何可衡量的影响。

sentences.en: There might be a confidence boost that comes with recognizing that you might have a little more money in your pocket this time next year.
sentences.zh: 意识到明年这个时候口袋里可能会多一点钱，可能会带来一种信心提升。

sentences.en: And President Trump has made this point repeatedly throughout his presidency that it's not just the concrete policies,
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统在整个任期内反复强调这一点，即不仅仅是具体的政策，

sentences.en: it's the intangible confidence that flows out of the policies.
sentences.zh: 还有从政策中流露出的无形信心。

sentences.en: He's saying that his policies have delivered this kind of shot of confidence, this tonic to the economy.
sentences.zh: 他是在说，他的政策为经济注入了这种信心，这种强心剂。

sentences.en: And the Staubs are merely a small example of something that's happening in tens of thousands of ways around the country.
sentences.zh: 而斯托布夫妇仅仅是全国各地以成千上万种方式发生的事情的一个小例子。

sentences.en: Then the speech takes a turn.
sentences.zh: 然后演讲话锋一转。

sentences.en: Here tonight are two fathers and two mothers, Evelyn Rodriguez, Freddy Cuevas, Elizabeth Alvarado, and Robert Mickens.
sentences.zh: 今晚在座的有两位父亲和两位母亲，伊芙琳·罗德里格斯、弗雷迪·奎瓦斯、伊丽莎白·阿尔瓦拉多和罗伯特·米肯斯。

sentences.en: Their two teenage daughters, Kayla Cuevas and Nisa Mickens, were close friends on Long Island.
sentences.zh: 他们的两个十几岁的女儿，凯拉·奎瓦斯和尼莎·米肯斯，是长岛的好朋友。

sentences.en: But in September 2016, on the eve of Nisa's 16th birthday, such a happy time it should have been, neither of them came home.
sentences.zh: 但在2016年9月，在尼莎16岁生日的前夕，本该是一个快乐的时刻，她们俩却都没有回家。

sentences.en: He talks about this gruesome murder of two teenage girls in Long Island perpetrated by members of this fearsome gang, MS-13,
sentences.zh: 他谈到了长岛两名少女被这个可怕的帮派“MS-13”成员残忍杀害的事件，

sentences.en: a gang that he never fails to point out, is fueled by our country's lax immigration laws.
sentences.zh: 这是一个他从不忘记指出是由我国宽松的移民法助长的帮派。

sentences.en: Many of these gang members took advantage of glaring loopholes in our laws to enter the country as illegal, unaccompanied, alien minors,
sentences.zh: 许多帮派成员利用我们法律中的明显漏洞，以非法、无人陪伴的未成年外国人身份进入该国，

sentences.en: and wound up in Kayla and Nisa's high school.
sentences.zh: 并最终进入了凯拉和尼莎就读的高中。

sentences.en: And the president doesn't say this, Mark, but he has just ended temporary protected status for El Salvador, which has been connected to the birth of MS-13.
sentences.zh: 总统没有明说，马克，但他刚刚结束了针对萨尔瓦多的临时保护身份，这与MS-13的诞生有关。

sentences.en: Yeah, that's right.
sentences.zh: 是的，没错。

sentences.en: This is kind of the implicit theme, if you will, of this part of the speech.
sentences.zh: 这可以说是演讲这一部分的隐含主题。

sentences.en: He doesn't want to come out and talk about withdrawing this protected status.
sentences.zh: 他不想直接出来谈论撤销这种保护身份。

sentences.en: It's an extremely fraught issue.
sentences.zh: 这是一个极其敏感的问题。

sentences.en: It would antagonize the Democrats sitting in the room.
sentences.zh: 这会激怒坐在房间里的民主党人。

sentences.en: But really, he doesn't have to, because particularly among his supporters within his base, just mentioning MS-13 and raising the specter of this gang gets the message across.
sentences.zh: 但实际上，他不必这样做，因为特别是在他的支持者和基本盘中，只要提到MS-13并唤起这个帮派的阴影，就能传达出信息。

sentences.en: Evelyn, Elizabeth, Freddie, and Robert, tonight everyone in this chamber is praying for you.
sentences.zh: 伊芙琳、伊丽莎白、弗雷迪和罗伯特，今晚在这个议事厅里的每个人都在为你们祈祷。

sentences.en: Everyone in America is grieving for you.
sentences.zh: 全美国的每个人都在为你们哀悼。

sentences.en: Please stand.
sentences.zh: 请起立。

sentences.en: Thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: And so the message here is, look, Democrats, if you want to have a discussion about dreamers, about these young undocumented people who came as young children,
sentences.zh: 所以这里的信息是，看，民主党人，如果你想讨论“梦想生”，讨论这些幼年时随父母非法入境的年轻人，

sentences.en: then we also need to have a conversation about all the other weaknesses in the immigration legal system
sentences.zh: 那么我们也需要讨论移民法律体系中所有其他弱点，

sentences.en: that allow all these unsavory and even dangerous and killer elements to come into the country.
sentences.zh: 这些弱点允许所有这些令人不快，甚至危险和杀戮的分子进入这个国家。

sentences.en: That's the price of my compromising with you on the dreamer issue.
sentences.zh: 这就是我在“梦想生”问题上与你们妥协的代价。

sentences.en: So this is what you've been talking about.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是你一直在谈论的。

sentences.en: He's satisfying his Republican and conservative base through these stories that he's telling.
sentences.zh: 他通过讲述这些故事来满足他的共和党和保守派基本盘。

sentences.en: But he's not coming out and explicitly saying anything particularly divisive about the policies that would seem to flow pretty naturally out of these stories.
sentences.zh: 但他并没有明确说出任何特别分裂的话，尽管这些政策似乎很自然地源于这些故事。

sentences.en: Yeah, that's right, because remember, the Democrats only voted to reopen the government a couple of weeks ago
sentences.zh: 是的，没错，因为记住，民主党人几周前才投票支持政府重新开门，

sentences.en: on the promise that there would be a real effort to find a compromise on immigration.
sentences.zh: 承诺会真正努力在移民问题上达成妥协。

sentences.en: So this is the next difficult legislative issue the president faces.
sentences.zh: 所以这是总统面临的下一个困难的立法问题。

sentences.en: He couldn't afford to come to the Capitol on Tuesday night and lay down the law in a way that antagonized the Democrats and burn bridges.
sentences.zh: 他周二晚不能去国会山以激怒民主党人并烧毁桥梁的方式发号施令。

sentences.en: So he was doing something rather delicate here, appealing to his base, but also keeping open the possibility for compromise.
sentences.zh: 所以他在这里做了一些相当微妙的事情，既吸引了他的基本盘，又为妥协留下了可能性。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 大家好，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at The New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我为《纽约时报》的每日通讯《DealBook》报道商业和政策。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市的DealBook峰会上现场采访一些商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的人物，包括J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine Lagarde, Zilron Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、齐尔隆·蒙达尼等等。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以观看其中一些毫无防备、未经剪辑的对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at NYTimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 我们将在11月18日通过NYTimes.com直播部分采访，供所有人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序来观看，并获得一个月的免费访问权限，阅读我们所有的报道。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你不会想错过的。

sentences.en: No regime has oppressed its own citizens more totally or brutally than the cruel dictatorship in North Korea.
sentences.zh: 没有哪个政权比朝鲜的残酷独裁统治更彻底或更残暴地压迫本国公民。

sentences.en: So what happens through the course of this speech is that the president pivots from this idea of strong Americans,
sentences.zh: 所以在这个演讲过程中发生的事情是，总统从强大的美国人这一理念，

sentences.en: heroic American figures helping one another, to Americans under siege,
sentences.zh: 从互相帮助的英雄美国人物，转向了处于围困中的美国人，

sentences.en: Americans victimized either by lawless immigrants who've come into the country, MS-13, or...
sentences.zh: 转向了被非法移民（MS-13）或……所伤害的美国人。

sentences.en: We need only look at the depraved character of the North Korean regime to understand the nature of the nuclear threat it could pose to America and to our allies.
sentences.zh: 我们只需看看朝鲜政权的堕落本质，就能理解它可能对美国及其盟友构成的核威胁。

sentences.en: By cruel foreign regimes, the North Koreans, this young college student...
sentences.zh: 被残酷的外国政权，朝鲜人，这个年轻的大学生……

sentences.en: Fred and Cindy Warmbier are here with us tonight, along with Otto's brother and sister...
sentences.zh: 弗雷德和辛迪·沃姆比尔今晚和我们在一起，还有奥托的兄弟姐妹……

sentences.en: ...who was detained in Pyongyang and fell into an irreversible coma.
sentences.zh: ……他在平壤被拘留并陷入了不可逆转的昏迷。

sentences.en: You are powerful witnesses to a menace that threatens our world, and your strength truly inspires us all.
sentences.zh: 你们是威胁我们世界的邪恶力量的有力见证人，你们的力量确实激励了我们所有人。

sentences.en: Thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: We are joined by one more witness to the ominous nature of this regime.
sentences.zh: 我们还有另一位见证该政权险恶本质的人加入。

sentences.en: His name is Mr. Ji Sung-ho.
sentences.zh: 他的名字是池成浩先生。

sentences.en: In 1996, Sung-ho was a starving boy in North Korea.
sentences.zh: 1996年，成浩是朝鲜一个挨饿的男孩。

sentences.en: One day he tried to steal coal from a railroad car to barter for a few scraps of food, which were very hard to get.
sentences.zh: 有一天，他试图从火车车厢里偷煤来换取一点食物，这在当时很难得到。

sentences.en: In the process, he passed out on the train tracks, exhausted from hunger.
sentences.zh: 在此过程中，他因饥饿而昏倒在铁轨上。

sentences.en: However, he woke up as a train ran over his limbs.
sentences.zh: 然而，当火车碾过他的四肢时，他醒了过来。

sentences.en: He then endured multiple amputations without anything to dull the pain or the hurt.
sentences.zh: 随后，他在没有任何止痛措施的情况下忍受了多次截肢手术。

sentences.en: Later, he was tortured by North Korean authorities after returning from a brief visit to China.
sentences.zh: 后来，他在短暂访问中国回国后，遭到了朝鲜当局的酷刑。

sentences.en: His tormentors wanted to know if he'd met any Christians.
sentences.zh: 折磨他的人想知道他是否见过基督徒。

sentences.en: He had, and he resolved, after that, to be free.
sentences.zh: 他见过，从那以后，他下定决心要获得自由。

sentences.en: So what's consistent through all of these stories is this notion of people who've really suffered greatly under extreme cruelty inflicted by evil foreigners, in effect.
sentences.zh: 所以，所有这些故事中贯穿始终的是这样一种观念：人们在邪恶外国人施加的极端残暴下遭受了巨大的痛苦。

sentences.en: Sung-ho's story is a testament to the yearning of every human soul to live in freedom.
sentences.zh: 成浩的故事证明了每个人类灵魂对生活在自由中的渴望。

sentences.en: It was that same yearning for freedom that nearly 250 years ago gave birth to a special place called America.
sentences.zh: 正是这种对自由的渴望，在近250年前孕育了一个名为美国的地方。

sentences.en: So it's a deeply nationalistic message, but it's embedded in these stories he's telling of almost operatic suffering and pain.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一个深刻的民族主义信息，但它嵌入了他讲述的那些近乎歌剧般苦难和痛苦的故事中。

sentences.en: Yes, that's right.
sentences.zh: 是的，没错。

sentences.en: I mean, he talks very little, for example, about what message the United States is trying to spread around the world.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他很少谈论美国试图向世界传播什么样的信息。

sentences.en: There's no discussion of American values or America as a model.
sentences.zh: 他没有讨论美国价值观，也没有把美国作为一个榜样来谈。

sentences.en: It's rather much that the country needs to fortify itself against these threats.
sentences.zh: 他更多谈到的是这个国家需要加强自身建设，以抵御这些威胁。

sentences.en: That means building a great wall on the southern border.
sentences.zh: 这意味着要在南部边境修建一堵大墙。

sentences.en: And, of course, in concrete terms, when he talks about fortifying the country, he's talking about the border wall.
sentences.zh: 当然，具体来说，当他谈到加强国家建设时，他指的就是边境墙。

sentences.en: When he's talking about North Korea, he's talking about...
sentences.zh: 当他谈到朝鲜时，他谈到的是……

sentences.en: We must modernize and rebuild our nuclear arsenal, hopefully never having to use it,
sentences.zh: 我们必须实现核武库的现代化和重建，希望永远不必使用它，

sentences.en: but making it so strong and so powerful that it will deter any acts of aggression by any other nation or anyone else.
sentences.zh: 但要让它变得如此强大，足以震慑任何其他国家或任何人的侵略行为。

sentences.en: So it's very much this notion of Fortress America trying to keep out these evil forces.
sentences.zh: 所以，这很大程度上是一种“堡垒美国”的理念，试图将这些邪恶势力拒之门外。

sentences.en: At the same time, I was struck that these stories were all about individuals
sentences.zh: 与此同时，令我印象深刻的是，这些故事讲的都是个人，

sentences.en: and that the president spoke to this idea of this being a moment where any individual can rise up and be great.
sentences.zh: 总统也提到了这样一个观点：这是一个任何个人都能崛起并成就伟大的时刻。

sentences.en: So to every citizen watching at home tonight, no matter where you've been or where you've come from, this is your time.
sentences.zh: 所以，今晚在家观看节目的每一位公民，无论你来自何方，无论你经历过什么，现在都是属于你们的时刻。

sentences.en: It seemed almost kind of removed from the idea of government and a kind of collective good from government.
sentences.zh: 这似乎与政府的理念以及政府所代表的集体利益有些脱节。

sentences.en: I think that's a very interesting observation.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是一个非常有趣的观察。

sentences.en: And I think what it reflects is that we have a president who doesn't put much weight in the ability of government to solve probleMs.
sentences.zh: 我认为这反映出我们有一位总统，他并不看重政府解决问题的能力。

sentences.en: He doesn't really think of the government as an institution to be respected, as a catalyst or an agent for good.
sentences.zh: 他并不真正认为政府是一个值得尊重的机构，也不认为它是推动进步的催化剂或代理人。

sentences.en: He really does think of the world as individuals.
sentences.zh: 他确实是以个人的视角来看待世界。

sentences.en: After all, if you look at his story, he's nothing more or less than an individual, a sort of a business superman who claimed his own destiny.
sentences.zh: 毕竟，如果你看看他的经历，他就是一个不折不扣的个人，一个掌控自己命运的商业超人。

sentences.en: So in a funny way, it makes a lot of sense that as Donald Trump looks around the world, he would be drawn to stories of individual acts of heroism, of defiance, of endurance.
sentences.zh: 所以有趣的是，当唐纳德·特朗普环顾世界时，他会被那些关于个人英雄主义、反抗和坚韧的故事所吸引，这在情理之中。

sentences.en: These are the kinds of stories that resonate with him much more, for example, than collective effort, a government working together, even a nation working together.
sentences.zh: 这些故事比集体努力、政府协作，甚至全国上下的共同努力更能引起他的共鸣。

sentences.en: Those are not themes you hear often from Trump.
sentences.zh: 这些并不是你经常从特朗普口中听到的主题。

sentences.en: You hear much more the power of the individual.
sentences.zh: 你听到更多的是个人的力量。

sentences.en: If you work hard, if you believe in yourself, if you believe in America, then you can dream anything.
sentences.zh: 如果你努力工作，如果你相信自己，如果你相信美国，那么你就能梦想一切。

sentences.en: You can be anything.
sentences.zh: 你可以成为任何你想成为的人。

sentences.en: And together, we can achieve absolutely anything.
sentences.zh: 只要齐心协力，我们绝对可以实现任何目标。

sentences.en: Speaking of things we don't often hear from Trump, I was also struck by what the president didn't say, Mark, on Tuesday.
sentences.zh: 说到我们不常从特朗普口中听到的内容，马克，周二总统没有说的话也让我印象深刻。

sentences.en: He very much stayed focused on these other Americans, these anecdotes he was telling throughout the night.
sentences.zh: 他非常专注于其他美国人，也就是他整晚讲述的那些轶事。

sentences.en: He really didn't focus on himself at all.
sentences.zh: 他确实一点也没有把焦点放在自己身上。

sentences.en: He didn't use the space of this speech to air his grievances, to fight his fights against the media, his frustration over the Russia investigation.
sentences.zh: 他没有利用这次演讲的机会来发泄不满，也没有利用它来与媒体进行斗争，或是表达对俄罗斯调查的沮丧。

sentences.en: So none of those battles that are playing out in Washington or on his Twitter feed were in this speech, really.
sentences.zh: 所以，那些在华盛顿或他的推特上上演的纷争，实际上并没有出现在这次演讲中。

sentences.en: And it ended up, for the most part, being about everyday Americans.
sentences.zh: 最终，演讲的大部分内容都是关于普通美国人的。

sentences.en: They are firefighters and police officers and border agents, medics and marines.
sentences.zh: 他们是消防员、警察、边境特工、医护人员和海军陆战队员。

sentences.en: But above all else, they are Americans.
sentences.zh: 但最重要的是，他们是美国人。

sentences.en: You're right.
sentences.zh: 你说得对。

sentences.en: And I think, again, that was very deliberate.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为，这同样是非常刻意的。

sentences.en: And I think what was driving it is the people around Donald Trump understand that he's the problem.
sentences.zh: 我认为背后的驱动力是唐纳德·特朗普身边的人明白，他本人就是问题所在。

sentences.en: I mean, part of the reason that this presidency has had such a difficult time is because he has so often thrust himself into the debate.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这届政府之所以举步维艰，部分原因在于他太频繁地将自己卷入争论之中。

sentences.en: And I think that Stephen Miller, who took the main hand in writing this speech, made a deliberate decision to pull the president out of the speech.
sentences.zh: 我认为斯蒂芬·米勒在撰写这篇演讲稿时起到了主导作用，他做出了一个深思熟虑的决定，要把总统从演讲中抽离出来。

sentences.en: This couldn't be a speech about Trump because Trump himself is just too much of a lightning rod.
sentences.zh: 这不能是一场关于特朗普的演讲，因为特朗普本人就是一个太大的争议焦点。

sentences.en: So I think they really tried to very much make it about a message embodied in other people.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为他们确实非常努力地将其变成了一个通过他人来体现的信息。

sentences.en: And again, he used other people's stories.
sentences.zh: 而且，他再次使用了他人的故事。

sentences.en: But the message was very much the strongman leader and the policies that will keep Americans not only great, but safe.
sentences.zh: 但核心信息依然是强人领导，以及那些不仅能让美国保持伟大，还能保障美国人安全的政策。

sentences.en: Mark, I was struck by a line in the speech that I think gets at this when the president said,
sentences.zh: 马克，演讲中有一句话让我印象深刻，我认为它触及了这一点，当时总统说：

sentences.en: Americans are dreamers, too.
sentences.zh: “美国人也是梦想家。”

sentences.en: That is perhaps one of the most important lines in this speech, because I think it again had that dual message.
sentences.zh: 这可能是演讲中最重要的一句话之一，因为我认为它再次传达了双重信息。

sentences.en: He was acknowledging the strong feelings surrounding the dreamers, but he was putting it into a different context, saying, make no mistake.
sentences.zh: 他承认了围绕“梦想家”的强烈情绪，但他将其置于不同的语境中，意思是：别搞错了。

sentences.en: My duty and the sacred duty of every elected official in this chamber is to defend Americans, to protect their safety, their families,
sentences.zh: 我的职责，以及本议会厅每一位民选官员的神圣职责，是捍卫美国人，保护他们的安全、他们的家庭、

sentences.en: their communities and their right to the American dream.
sentences.zh: 他们的社区以及他们享有美国梦的权利。

sentences.en: I'm not interested in the special pleadings of one group or another group.
sentences.zh: 我对某个特定群体或团体的特殊诉求不感兴趣。

sentences.en: I'm interested in the entire American population and the great American dream.
sentences.zh: 我关心的是全体美国人民和伟大的美国梦。

sentences.en: And I think the way he encapsulated it there was something that resonated a lot with his political base.
sentences.zh: 我认为他在这里的概括方式引起了他政治基本盘的强烈共鸣。

sentences.en: The people dreamed this country.
sentences.zh: 是人民梦想了这个国家。

sentences.en: The people built this country.
sentences.zh: 是人民建设了这个国家。

sentences.en: And it's the people who are making America great again.
sentences.zh: 正是人民让美国再次伟大。

sentences.en: Mark, it is very late.
sentences.zh: 马克，时间很晚了。

sentences.en: It's actually Wednesday morning.
sentences.zh: 现在已经是周三早上了。

sentences.en: Thank you very much for coming on.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你来参加节目。

sentences.en: Glad to be here, Michael.
sentences.zh: 很高兴来到这里，迈克尔。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: And God bless America.
sentences.zh: 上帝保佑美国。

sentences.en: Good night.
sentences.zh: 晚安。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的其他新闻。

sentences.en: On Tuesday evening,
sentences.zh: 周二晚上，

sentences.en: White House Press Secretary Sarah Huckabee Sanders said that President Trump has no plans to release the controversial memo prepared by Republicans on the House Intelligence Committee,
sentences.zh: 白宫新闻秘书萨拉·赫卡比·桑德斯表示，特朗普总统没有计划公布由众议院情报委员会共和党人准备的那份备受争议的备忘录，

sentences.en: accusing the FBI, accusing the FBI of abusing its power in the Russia investigation.
sentences.zh: 该备忘录指控联邦调查局在俄罗斯调查中滥用权力。

sentences.en: Let's release the memo.
sentences.zh: 让我们公布那份备忘录吧。

sentences.en: But a few hours later, as he walked out of the House chamber after the State of the Union speech,
sentences.zh: 但几个小时后，当他发表完国情咨文走出众议院大厅时，

sentences.en: Trump had a different message for a Republican congressman who encouraged him to make the memo public.
sentences.zh: 特朗普对一位鼓励他公开备忘录的共和党国会议员表达了不同的态度。

sentences.en: Let's release the memo.
sentences.zh: 让我们公布那份备忘录吧。

sentences.en: Don't worry.
sentences.zh: 别担心。
百分之百。

sentences.en: And there is a new understanding of what happened on the morning of January 13th when millions of people in Hawaii received emergency alerts to their phones about an incoming missile attack.
sentences.zh: 关于1月13日早晨发生的事情，现在有了新的了解，当时夏威夷数百万人手机上收到了导弹袭击的紧急警报。

sentences.en: The Times reports that the emergency management services worker responsible for sending the alert had a history of poor performance
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》报道称，负责发送警报的应急管理部门工作人员有工作表现不佳的历史，

sentences.en: and sent the warning not by accident, as previously reported, but because he misunderstood the test instructions he had received from a supervisor
sentences.zh: 他发送警告并非如之前报道的那样是意外，而是因为他误解了从主管那里收到的测试指令，

sentences.en: and believed the state was facing an actual threat.
sentences.zh: 并认为该州正面临真实的威胁。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直像一台严密控制的机器一样运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 选举迎来了一批自称改革派的人士。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党一直陷入一场激烈、混乱，有时甚至令人兴奋的斗争中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在《Metro》的最新一集中，我和萨拉·凯尼格将讲述人们试图维持影响力却在过程中失去控制的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: 《Metro》。

sentences.en: Listen wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 欢迎在任何收听播客的地方订阅收听。
